NOTICE OF MEETING ADJOURNMENT

  OF THE FOLLOWING:
REGULAR MEETING OF THE PLANNING COMMISION

  NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the regularly scheduled meeting
of the Planning Commission of the City of Baldwin Park scheduled for
Wednesday, February 8, 2023, was ADJOURNED.

  DUE TO LACK OF QUORUM
  Said meeting was to be held in the Council Chambers,
14403 E. Pacific Avenue, Baldwin Park CA, at 7:00 pm.

Items to be continued to the next Regular Meeting of the Planning
Commission scheduled for Wednesday, February 22, 2023, at 7:00
p.m., Council Chambers, 14403 E. Pacific Avenue, Baldwin Park, CA.
  Notice of Adjournment was posted on the City Hall bulletin board.

  Dated this 9th day of February 2023

  Fabiola Zelaya-Melicher
  Planning Commission Secretary

ADJOURNMENT

The regularly scheduled meeting for the Planning Commission of the City of Baldwin Park on
Wednesday, February 8, 2023, was ADJOURNED due to lack of quorum. Voting on January 25, 2023,
minutes will take place at the meeting scheduled on February 22, 2023.

Items on the February 8, 2023, meeting were continued to the next regular meeting of the Planning
Commission scheduled for Wednesday, February 22, 2023, at 7: 00 p. m., Council Chambers, 14403 E.
Pacific Avenue, Baldwin Park, CA.

The meeting was ADJOURNED by Marco Ornelas Lopez, Assistant City Attorney at 7: 23 p. m.
